lead: What SYLY stores, for learners and for developers, and how to delete it.
learn1: Questions are stored without a name or contact, only to show teachers the most asked questions (counts only).
learn2: A question goes to an online AI service only if the learner chooses Allow online answers. Nothing about who the learner is is sent. Voice notes in the Telegram bot also need this choice.
learn3: If a learner asks for a person, the request, the messages and any contact detail (a Telegram chat or a phone number) are stored. Contact details are encrypted.
learn4: A learner can download or delete everything held for them: in the assistant under Your data, in Telegram with /mydata and /delete, or by text message with STOP.
dev1: When you sign in with Google we store your Google account id (sub), your e-mail address and your name. Nothing else from Google. We ask only for openid, email and profile.
dev2: For each site you add we store its name, allowed origins, the widget settings you choose, and an optional public Telegram bot name. A site key (starting pk_) is public and goes in your page source. We store no secrets for a site.
dev3: We never receive your Telegram bot token. Keep it only in your own server's .env.
dev4: The sign-in uses one cookie, set only when you sign in. It is HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and lasts 7 days. There are no analytics or advertising cookies.
del1: Developers: in the dashboard choose Delete my account and sites. Your account and all your sites are removed at once. Download my data gives you a JSON file first.
del2: Learners: see above. Ask the site owner if you need help.
noteP: This is a hackathon prototype. Use test data only; do not enter real personal information. The licence is to be confirmed.
